binding_source_commit_semantics: validation/tooling/dev23-candidate-binding.json source_commit binds the reviewed product/source candidate, not the validation-tooling implementation commit.
bridge_source_commit_semantics: The bridge task source_commit identifies the Git base from which task input files were loaded. It is packet provenance and is NOT universally the final candidate target. Final tooling target identity is commit_roles.tooling_final_target. Candidate binding source_commit is commit_roles.product_source by design.

canonical_control_state.meaning: Main V91 control-plane state authorizing the bounded review.

declared_historical_base.meaning: BASE_VALIDATION_COMMIT declared by TEST_CHANGE 009 and used by historical-byte hardcut regression.

product_source.meaning: Reviewed dev23 product/source candidate. validation/tooling/dev23-candidate-binding.json source_commit intentionally refers to this identity.

tooling_final_target.meaning: Exact final validation-tooling code-review target. This is the candidate to promote to lane/validation-p00 after PASS.

tooling_validation_base.meaning: Owning validation lane head before successor tooling promotion.

promotion_semantics: Only commit_roles.tooling_final_target is eligible for promotion to lane/validation-p00 after final CODE_REVIEW PASS. Review-support commits are never promotion targets.
